name: Fettuccine Alfredo with Tuna, Capers, Lemon & Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g fettuccine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a medium saucepan.
Drain tuna, add to the pan with the lemon juice, and break into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Add Alfredo sauce, capers, and spices to the pan. Stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (454 g) jars Alfredo sauce
6 tbsp capers
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and set aside for serving.
Once the sauce is simmering, remove from heat and cover with a lid to keep warm.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add the warm sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide pasta and arugula between plates. Top arugula with tomatoes, then drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
